card.name: Median time values before a range
card.fires_on: The unit or opening parenthesis right after a median time figure (days, weeks, months) in adverse-event or efficacy summaries, just before the range or confidence interval is given. Also a number before a CI.

modes.label: Median time unit
modes.description: The time unit or following parenthesis after a median time to onset or resolution.

modes.label: Value before interval
modes.description: A number or measure just before a confidence interval or comparison.

card.writes: Suppresses the plus-minus sign and similar tokens, so a range or interval is expected instead of a spread symbol; the promoted tokens show no clear link.
card.plain: It fires after a median time such as 30 days, just where the text is about to give the range.
